final: WITH f AS (SELECT raceId, points, wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0), per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM f GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins IS NULL), diff DESC LIMIT 10
